title: zephyranthes rositae
intro: Zephyranthes rositae, commonly known as the Rosita's Zephyr Lily or Pink Zephyr, is a species of flowering plant in the family Amaryllidaceae. It is traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, respiratory issues, and digestive problems, due to its potential health benefits. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antiviral properties, which can help alleviate symptoms and promote recovery. The bioactive constituents present in Zephyranthes rositae include alkaloids, saponins, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
